name: Grace Randolph
biography: Grace Randolph (born February 5, 1987) is an American comic book writer and the hostess and creator of the YouTube channels Beyond the Trailer, Movie Math, and Think About the Ink. She has written numerous comics, including Justice League Unlimited and X-Men: Nation X, as well as creating the original comic book series Grace Randolph's Supurbia.
birthplace: New York City, New York, USA
